title: What training would help your research?
text: Data Science Services at IQSS runs free workshops, consultations, and guides for researchers at Harvard and MIT. Tell us what you would come to, and we will plan next year’s sessions around the answers.Nine questions, about two minutes.1What is your role?RequiredFacultyPostdoc or research scientistDoctoral studentMaster’s studentUndergraduateResearch staffresearch assistant, data analyst, lab managerAdministrative or professional staff2Which school are you in?RequiredChoose oneFaculty of Arts and SciencesSchool of Engineering and Applied SciencesBusiness SchoolChan School of Public HealthDivinity SchoolGraduate School of DesignGraduate School of EducationKennedy SchoolLaw SchoolMedical School, School of Dental Medicine, or an affiliated hospitalRadcliffe InstituteOther Harvard unitMITElsewhereDepartment or program3How much code do you write for your research?RequiredNone. I use point-and-click software, or no software at all.None myself. AI tools write code for me.Occasionally, often by adapting someone else’s code.Most weeks.Most days. It is a main part of my work.4Which of these do you use?RequiredChoose all that apply.RPythonStataSPSS, SAS, or other statistics softwareAn AI coding assistant or agentNone of the above5Which topics would you most like training in?RequiredChoose up to five.Getting startedProgramming basicsin R, Python, or StataData cleaning and visualizationIntroductory statisticsResearch workflowReproducible researchGit, project organization, environmentsCollecting dataweb scraping, APIsUsing AI agents in researchwhat they can do, checking their work, responsible useAI tools and sensitive dataprivacy, data retention, IRB and DUA complianceMethods: intermediate and advancedRegression and statistical modelingGLMs, multilevel and longitudinal modelsCausal inferenceexperiments, difference-in-differences, IV, matching and weightingBayesian analysisStudy design and power analysisincluding power by simulationExploratory data analysis and pre-registration plansMachine learningincluding deep learningText analysisincluding with LLMs6Which of these would you attend?RequiredChoose all that apply.A 60–90 minute talk or demonstrationyou watch and ask questionsA 90 minute workshopyou follow along on your own laptopA 3 hour hands-on workshopwith exercises you work throughA series of 2–4 sessions over a few weeksA 2–3 day bootcampfull days of teaching and exercisesA self-paced written guideRecorded webinars you can watch in your own time7How would you prefer to attend a live session?RequiredIn personOnline, on ZoomEither is fineI would prefer to watch the recording later8Anything else you would like us to know?For example, a topic we missed, or the times of year or week that suit you.9Would you like to hear from us?Tell me when sessions are scheduledMy lab, group, or department would like a session run for usI would like help with a project of my ownYour emailNeeded if you ticked a box above.Website SubmitThank youThank you. We will use your answers to plan next year’s training. If you asked us to get in touch, we will write to you at the address you gave.
